posts.caption: it’s nice to be here 🤍🫶

pov: you spend an afternoon with @lazzoni to design your dream closet system. #ad

i had the pleasure of visiting the Costa Mesa flagship to envision the most bespoke closet system, customized down to the walnut interiors, leather touches, storage modules, and lighting system.

i love that Lazzoni prioritizes real materials and craftsmanship, and has been family-owned since 1897, with a global design house and in-house services dedicated to creating top tier custom furniture. it was so easy to book an appointment, view the full scope of design services and finishings, and then design it live with the designer. once designed, Lazzoni will put the project into production, and then send a professional team to install this closet over the course of a few hours.

i can’t wait to bring this into my home one day, and i trust @lazzoni to turn the vision into something I’ll enjoy as a daily ritual for years to come.

📍Lazzoni, Costa Mesa (gifted partnership)
